title: 'When we tell them pregnancies require regular medical checkups, they scoff': Afghan women's health is put at risk by the Taliban
subhed: 'Voices of Afghan Women' (4/6). Only women can care for women, yet Afghanistan is no longer training female doctors, nurses, or midwives. As a result, women's access to healthcare is becoming increasingly difficult, sometimes with tragic consequences, and undermines their mental health, as they told our special correspondent in Kabul.

title: 'Fjord' by Cristian Mungiu, Cannes Palme d'Or winner: A clash of opposing worlds
subhed: A deeply religious Romanian evangelical family, newly settled in a small Norwegian town, clashes with the country's liberal principles and ultimately the courts when the couple is suspected of child abuse.

title: Nicolas Altmayer, producer of hit French comedies, dies at 61
subhed: A key figure in French cinema, Nicolas Altmayer co-founded Mandarin & Compagnie with his brother, Eric. The production company backed 'Brice de Nice,' 'OSS 117,' and 10 films by François Ozon. He died on August 17 at age 61.

title: Jean Hegland, American novelist: 'The idea that humans must dominate the Earth and animals has not served us well'

title: Why are heatwaves becoming more frequent in France?
subhed: Between May and July, France was the most abnormally hot country in the world, compared to its average heat index. While the role of global warming is not under debate, the frequency of this summer's heatwaves is a topic of scientific debate.
